title: 第17章 时间差不多了第18章 这个机器不是我做的
slug: 不过是穿梭万界为啥都管我叫爹
content_zh:
“其实不用这样，我只是短暂地离开而已，将来还会回来看望大家的。”
这一刻连童元安也被深深打动了。
为了给他送行甚至不惜冒着巨大风险夜探险林捕捉魔兽，这样的深厚情谊怎能让人不动容。
“这些东西实在太多了，我只需要取走一小部分即可。
剩下的大家留着以后使用吧。”
尽管这样建议但是所有村民还是坚持要求让童元安全部接受下来。
“请务必收下我们这份心意，要不然以后我们真的无法心安。”
族长真诚地恳求着。
虽然跟童元安为村子做出的贡献相比，这些礼品确实微不足道。
但如果不是时间太紧，大家还真希望再多准备出十倍之数！
考虑到此情景童元安只能勉为其难答应，并且开始担心这么多物资如何妥善运送到另一端？
幸好他还记得计划中的帮手，于是望向身旁表情略显不解的后土笑了笑。
因为在这个古老的世界里面随处可见普通动物和植被似乎无需特意打包带走……不过她并未过多追问而是直接轻轻扬起手，所有的物品就这样神奇地被转移走了。
对于即将踏上的未知旅途反而更加充满期待。
“果然够强大啊！”
心中不禁暗暗佩服这位同伴超乎常人的储物技巧。
告别仪式完成后两人便一同启程离开。
身后留下的是全体村民依依不舍的目光直到最后身影彻底消失……
与此同时村里再次回归了繁忙景象，在首领的带领下大家又开始了新一天的工作。
就在所有人热火朝天干得兴起之时，巫师忽然加入了队伍中满脸凝重的表情……

“童元安小兄弟说了，他的所有发明都是为了让大家族过得更好，咱们扶风部落不能光顾着自己享受。”
巫师一开口，立马得到了大家的响应。
“巫师大人说得对，小兄弟这么帮我们，虽说我们没有他那样的能耐，但也不能太自私，凉了他的心！”
“我有个主意，咱们可以按小组分工，每个小组负责学会一种工具的制作，学会了再去教别的部落。”
“这主意真好！
我来带队练太极！”
“我带人做桌椅！”
“那制造餐具的小队就交给我吧！”
……
每个人都多少有点私心，但是也能无私，这主要看周围的人和事怎么影响的。
童元安用自己的实际行动赢得了扶风部落所有人的尊敬和信任，人们心中渐渐萌发了团结一致的想法。
大伙儿都很激动，觉得虽然人类很弱小，但也应该彼此扶持才能走下去。
大家虽然学识有限，但也能看出，只要把童元安带来的东西推广开去，肯定会给人类带来极大的好处。
只有整个种族强大了，才不会再被外族欺负。
更重要的是，所有人都相信，有人像童元安这么聪明的人在，未来一定会变得光明起来。
谁也不会质疑童元安说的话，他说会再来就一定还会再来的。
等他下次回来时，一定要让扶风部落焕然一新才行！
此时，童元安跟后土两人已经离开了扶风部落百多里远。
后土疑惑地看着童元安。
content_en:
"Actually, it doesn't have to be like this. I'm just leaving for a short time. I will come back to visit you in the future."
Even Tong Yuanan was deeply moved by this moment.
In order to see him off, he even risked a lot to explore the forest at night to capture the monsters. How could such a deep friendship leave people unmoved.
“There’s just so much of it that I only need to take a small amount away.
Let’s save the rest for later use. "
Despite this suggestion, all the villagers still insisted that Tong Yuan's Security Department accept it.
"Please be sure to accept our wishes, otherwise we will really not be able to feel at ease in the future."
The patriarch begged sincerely.
Although compared with Tong Yuanan's contribution to the village, these gifts are indeed insignificant.
But if time hadn’t been so tight, we would have really hoped to prepare ten times more!
Considering this situation, Tong Yuanan could only reluctantly agree, and began to worry about how to properly transport so many supplies to the other side?
Fortunately, he still remembered the helper in the plan, so he looked at Houtu beside him, who looked slightly puzzled, and smiled.
因为在这个古老的世界里面随处可见普通动物和植被似乎无需特意打包带走……不过她并未过多追问而是直接轻轻扬起手，所有的物品就这样神奇地被转移走了。
I am even more excited about the unknown journey I am about to embark on.
"It's indeed powerful enough!"
I couldn't help but secretly admire this companion's extraordinary storage skills.
After the farewell ceremony was completed, the two set off together to leave.
What was left behind were the reluctant eyes of all the villagers until the figure finally disappeared completely...
At the same time, the village returned to a busy scene again, and everyone started a new day's work under the leadership of the leader.
Just when everyone was getting excited, the wizard suddenly joined the team with solemn expressions on their faces...
"Brother Tong Yuanan said that all his inventions are to make the big family live a better life. Our Fufeng tribe cannot just enjoy it for ourselves."
As soon as the wizard opened his mouth, he received an immediate response from everyone.
"Master Wizard is right. Little brother is helping us like this. Although we don't have the ability like him, we can't be too selfish and make him feel bad!"
"I have an idea. We can divide the work into groups. Each group is responsible for learning how to make a tool, and then teach it to other tribes."
"What a great idea!
I'll lead the team to practice Tai Chi! "
"I'll bring people to make tables and chairs!"
"Then leave the tableware manufacturing team to me!"
…
Everyone is somewhat selfish, but they can also be selfless. It mainly depends on the influence of the people and things around them.
Tong Yuanan used his practical actions to win the respect and trust of everyone in the Fufeng tribe, and the idea of ​​unity gradually emerged in people's hearts.
Everyone was very excited and felt that although humans are very weak, they should support each other to move forward.
Although everyone has limited knowledge, they can still see that as long as what Tong Yuanan brings is promoted, it will definitely bring great benefits to mankind.
Only when the entire race is strong will it no longer be bullied by foreign races.
More importantly, everyone believes that with someone as smart as Tong Yuanan around, the future will definitely become brighter.
No one will question what Tong Yuanan said. If he said he would come again, he would definitely come again.
When he comes back next time, he must give the Fufeng tribe a completely new look!
At this time, Tong Yuanan and Hou Tu had already left the Fufeng tribe for more than a hundred miles.
Hou Tu looked at Tong Yuanan doubtfully.
